title: carex neglecta

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and to treat digestive problems, such as constipation and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Carex neglecta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
